comment: The scanner/tool binaries whose OUTPUT commitwork trusts. monitor/scanner-binary.mjs pins each one (resolved path + sha256 + version string) against an accepted baseline; any deviation is a diff to re-accept, never a silent change. versionArgs is per-tool because there is no convention. Entry scripts (semgrep, prowler, guarddog, depscan are Python launchers) are hashed as resolved — the version output is the second witness that reaches the package behind the launcher; the two cannot share a failure mode.
